Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of as-prepared CuxNiy/MgAlO nanocatalysts showed two obvious reflections at 2θ = 43.33–44.46° and 2θ = 50.44–51.85°, which were assigned to (111) and (200) crystal planes of face-centred cubic (fcc) structure (Fig. 1B). The XRD diffraction patterns of resultant CuNi/MgAlO-T catalysts showed three characteristic diffraction peaks at 2θ = 43.81°, 51.06°, and 75.16°, which were ascribed to the (111), (200), and (220) crystal planes of CuNi alloys, respectively (Fig. 3).
